headline: Indian Markets Prepare For Muhurat Trading Following Strongest Weekly Rally In Years

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian stock market posted its best weekly performance in years, bucking global tech routs.
Sensex surged over 1,700 points to cross 81,000, while Nifty reclaimed key psychological levels.
Investor wealth increased by Rs 29.57 lakh crore during the pre-Diwali rally.
Markets enter Samvat 2083 with strong momentum ahead of the special Muhurat Trading session.
whatHappening: Dalal Street opens today for the traditional Diwali Muhurat Trading session to mark Samvat 2083.
Multiple corporate actions and dividend announcements are scheduled for companies like HUL, Dabur, and ONGC.
Indian benchmarks decoupled from global selloffs in Asian and US tech stocks.
Nifty 50 enters the new Hindu accounting year with key support and resistance levels in focus.
summary: Indian equities enter Samvat 2083 on a high note following a record weekly rally that added Rs 29.57 lakh crore to investor wealth. The stock exchanges are holding the traditional Muhurat Trading session today for Diwali Laxmi Pujan. Major stocks like HUL, Dabur, and ONGC remain in focus due to upcoming corporate actions and dividend payouts.
